finding.title: CLI and witness JSON files were unbounded before parsing
finding.consequence: Malformed UTF-8 could escape the CLI's fail-closed error contract, and arbitrarily large JSON files were fully loaded before semantic size checks, permitting avoidable local memory exhaustion.
finding.required_repair: Read at most the configured limit plus one byte, reject excess bytes before decoding, decode strict UTF-8, parse with bounded depth/shape validation and route errors to HELD.

nonclaim: Local parser-boundary evidence only; it does not establish remote input reachability or complete denial-of-service resistance.
